name: freqhole-release
description: release coordination (changesets + version sync) for freqhole. not published.

scripts.version: changeset version && make bump-version NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && npm --prefix client/spume install
scripts.publish:npm:midden:local: cd client/midden && make build-release-npm && cd pkg && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:npm:local: npm run publish:npm:api-client:local && npm run publish:npm:midden:local
